_comment: English body for prompt-case-citation-check. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output a claim-citation check table; unsupported or misplaced citations are flagged.
Inputs: Text with citations and source excerpts.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Check the text sentence by sentence. Output checks[] with claim, citation, source_excerpt, verdict (supported/unsupported/misplaced), and reason. source_excerpt must come from the supplied excerpts; if no matching excerpt exists, verdict=unsupported. Do not use common knowledge as evidence.
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.预期输出形态: checks[] with verdict and reason per claim.
sections.检查点:
- Each verdict has a source_excerpt or explicit absence.
- Misplaced citations identify the correct source.
- No external common knowledge is introduced.
sections.失败分支:
- Insufficient excerpts: add excerpts and recheck.
- Claim too broad: split into checkable subclaims.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.
